### Step 1: Compute Initial Terms

Using the formula $ a(n) = 2n^3 - n $, we compute the first few terms:

$$
\begin{align*}
a(0) &= 2(0)^3 - 0 = 0, \\
a(1) &= 2(1)^3 - 1 = 1, \\
a(2) &= 2(8) - 2 = 14, \\
a(3) &= 2(27) - 3 = 51, \\
a(4) &= 2(64) - 4 = 124, \\
a(5) &= 2(125) - 5 = 245.
\end{align*}
$$

- **First differences**:

  \Delta_2 &= a(2) - a(1) = 14 - 1 = 13, \\
  \Delta_3 &= a(3) - a(2) = 51 - 14 = 37, \\
  \Delta_4 &= a(4) - a(3) = 124 - 51 = 73, \\
  \Delta_5 &= a(5) - a(4) = 245 - 124 = 121.
  \end{align*}
  $$

$$
a(n) = 4a(n-1) - 6a(n-2) + 4a(n-3) - a(n-4),
